name: Push Notifications (ntfy)
description: Self-hosted push notifications via ntfy. Instant delivery to any device with the ntfy app.
author: Crow
notes: Crow sets itself up automatically: after install it creates its own login on this server, picks a private topic, and hands a read-only key to the Crow Android app (Settings › Notifications shows the status, the phone address, and a test button). Each Crow instance on this computer gets its own topic. The server runs with deny-all default access, so topics are private.
